source.title: W25 — Real-Time Events & Notifications: E2E Verification
source.body:
# W25 — Reliable Real-time Notifications and Operational Events

**Audit/acceptance tracker; not new implementation ownership.** Owner requires **real-time** server-confirmed updates in this W25/W26 phase, not manual refresh. Historical Done issues are not proof of functioning browser streaming. Design-first audit only; no code, Git, DB, Linear changes by coding agents. Read current repo before selecting SSE/WebSocket. Cloud Neon must not be used for mutating tests. Use isolated disposable \*\_test DB for real acceptance.

## Should-be scope

* Online customer sees customer-safe order state, availability action required, approved amendment, delivery/return/refund and support changes **without refresh**. Supplier sees only their own PO updates, Hub only its own receiving/preparation/dispatch queue, support only authorized urgent cases. Driver assignment only if current driver surface exists.
* Reuse canonical owner-domain committed state, existing AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#18 durable Notification Outbox and AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#67 domain events if appropriate. Real-time transport does NOT own workflow state; backend REST API remains authoritative for all writes. Event has eventId/type/entityId/version/cursor and minimum non-sensitive content; frontend refetches canonical projection. Never broadcast sensitive supplier cost, internal notes, prices from unsanitized records or customer PII.
* **Transport proposal:** Prefer authenticated NestJS SSE for server-to-client push if code inspection confirms a largely one-way flow; use existing WebSocket if already present/justified. No Redis/Kafka/new broker or paid messaging provider by default. External WhatsApp/DM delivery is independent of website real-time and not promised immediate.
* Strict server-side scoped subscriptions: customer Order ownership, guest opaque token/session, supplierId, Hub assigned location, Driver assigned run, support/admin permissions. For browser SSE, native EventSource cannot attach custom Authorization headers: choose safe same-origin HttpOnly-cookie auth or authenticated fetch streaming; never include guest token in URL or logs. Check auth revocation and CORS.
* Reliability: committed-event delivery only, deduped events and meaningful notifications, no optimistic state changes, reconnect/heartbeat, cursor or canonical REST snapshot on missing messages, jitter/backoff and safe polling fallback. React Query targeted invalidation. Test multiple tabs, process restart, slow/offline network, duplicate/out-of-order events, and deployment proxy buffering/timeouts. Single-process MVP okay if limitation and multi-instance rollout boundary explicit; don't assume in-memory event emitter works across replicas.
* Notification center backed by durable read/unread records, not transient stream only; meaningful customer events only, no spam on every sourcing step; actionable links point to owner-domain decision.

## Acceptance matrix

1. Two browsers see same current Order after one confirmed change, with no refresh or duplicate side effects.
2. Supplier A vs B, Hub A vs B, Customer A vs B and guest invalid access: no cross-tenant subscriptions or event data leaks even with guessed IDs.
3. Timeout/reconnect/server restart restores exact current status/COD/refund and unread state via trusted REST snapshot.
4. One outbox event retried multiple times does not duplicate notifications/actions.
5. Safety/support P0 event reaches human operator queue, not just an unhandled outbox record.
6. Render truthful customer-safe event only after committed transaction; provider/stream outage does not affect actual Order state.
7. Server connection cleanup and production proxy/multiple-instance strategy assessed.

## Existing implementation ownership

AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#18 Outbox (Done), AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#67 events (Done), [GLO-74](https://linear.app/ahme-hassan/issue/GLO-74/implement-order-readstatus-apis) status (Done), [GLO-83](https://linear.app/ahme-hassan/issue/GLO-83/build-hub-operations-console) Hub UI (Todo), AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#2 Supplier UI (Backlog), AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#19 support queue (Backlog), [GLO-91](https://linear.app/ahme-hassan/issue/GLO-91/close-critical-tests-authsecurity-and-failure-paths)/205 security/testing and [GLO-93](https://linear.app/ahme-hassan/issue/GLO-93/run-end-to-end-release-candidate-smoke-test) E2E. **W25 remains UNVERIFIED** until safe stream + REST persisted state E2E evidence. No code implementation from this audit ticket.
